feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 30 September 2026 5:06pm
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Wednesday, 30 September 2026 at 4:45pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds.


##Synopsis##

A deep area of low pressure to the west of Ireland tracks north and fills.


##Wind##

South 5 or 6, but 4 towards Liverpool Bay, gradually decreasing southwest 4 or 5 in all waters by late evening.


##State of Sea##

Moderate, occasionally rough in the west of the area at first, but slight towards Liverpool Bay, falling slight or moderate in all waters overnight.


##Weather##

Isolated showers, becoming fair later.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate in any showers.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

Southwest 4 or 5, increasing south or southwest 5 or 6 tomorrow evening, then perhaps occasionally 7 Friday afternoon.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate, becoming mainly moderate.


##Weather##

Rain and showers spread from the west overnight into Friday.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate in rain or showers.
